faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to the most common questions about our store.
faq.a_ship1: Standard delivery takes 3–5 business days. Express delivery is available in 1–2 business days for an additional fee.
faq.a_ship2: Yes! Orders over $50 qualify for free standard shipping across Azerbaijan.
faq.a_ship3: Currently we ship within Azerbaijan only. International shipping is coming soon.
faq.a_ret1: We offer a 30-day hassle-free return policy on most items. Products must be unused and in original packaging.
faq.q_ret2: How do I start a return?
faq.a_ret2: Contact our support team via the Contact page or email us at support@techvibe.az. We'll guide you through the process.
faq.q_ret3: When will I receive my refund?
faq.a_ret3: Refunds are processed within 5–7 business days after we receive the returned item.
faq.q_pay1: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a_pay1: We accept Visa, Mastercard, Google Pay, and Cash on Delivery.
faq.a_pay2: Absolutely. All transactions are encrypted with SSL and we never store your full card details.
faq.a_pay3: Installment options are available through select bank partners. Look for the installment badge on product pages.
faq.a_ord1: Yes, orders can be cancelled within 1 hour of placement. After that, please contact support.
faq.q_ord2: How do I track my order?
faq.a_ord2: Once your order ships, you'll receive a tracking link via email. You can also check status in your Profile → Orders.
faq.q_ord3: What if I receive a damaged item?
faq.a_ord3: Please contact us within 48 hours of delivery with photos of the damage. We'll arrange a replacement or refund immediately.
faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Our support team is available Mon–Sat, 10:00–21:00 and ready to help.

returns.subtitle: Simple, straightforward returns. Your satisfaction is our priority.
returns.step1Desc: Reach out to our support team via email or the contact form to initiate your return.
returns.step2Desc: Place the item in its original packaging with all accessories and documentation.
returns.step3Desc: Use our prepaid return label (provided by email) to send the item back to us.
returns.step4Desc: Once we receive and inspect the item, your refund will be processed within 5–7 business days.
returns.elig1: Items returned within 30 days of delivery
returns.elig3: Items with all original accessories included
returns.refundNote: Refunds are credited back to the original payment method. Processing time may vary depending on your bank or card provider (typically 3–10 business days).

about.title: Passionate About Technology
about.subtitle: TechVibe was founded with a simple mission: to make premium technology accessible to everyone in Azerbaijan and beyond.
about.storyP1: TechVibe was born in 2020 in Baku, Azerbaijan. What started as a small passion project quickly grew into one of the region's leading online technology retailers.
about.storyP2: Today, we serve over 50,000 customers with a catalog of 5,000+ products from 30+ globally recognized brands — all backed by fast delivery and exceptional support.
about.valuesSubtitle: Our core values guide everything we do.
about.val1Desc: We curate the latest and most innovative tech products from around the world.
about.val2Desc: Every decision we make puts our customers' needs and satisfaction first.
about.val3Desc: We only sell authentic, high-quality products from trusted brands.
about.val4Desc: Proudly Azerbaijani, serving our community with care and dedication.
about.val5Desc: Recognized for outstanding customer service and fast delivery.
about.val6Desc: Clear pricing, honest reviews, and no hidden fees. Ever.
about.ctaDesc: Browse thousands of tech products and find exactly what you're looking for.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy describes how TechVibe collects, uses, and protects your personal information. By using our services, you agree to the practices described in this policy.
privacy.s1Body: We collect information you provide directly to us, such as your name, email address, shipping address, and payment information when you create an account or place an order. We also automatically collect usage data, including pages visited, products viewed, and browser information.
privacy.s2Body: We use your information to process orders and payments, provide customer support, send order confirmations and shipping updates, personalize your shopping experience, and send promotional communications (with your consent).
privacy.s3Body: We do not sell or rent your personal information to third parties. We share your data only with service providers necessary to operate our business (e.g., payment processors, shipping carriers), and only as required by law.
privacy.s4Body: We implement industry-standard security measures including SSL encryption, secure data storage, and regular security audits to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, disclosure, or misuse.
privacy.s5Body: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information at any time. You may also opt out of marketing communications by clicking the unsubscribe link in any email or by contacting us directly.
privacy.s6Body: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your browsing experience, analyze site traffic, and personalize content. You can manage your cookie preferences through your browser settings.
privacy.contact: For privacy-related questions, contact us at:

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: By accessing or using TechVibe, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. Please read them carefully before using our services.
terms.s1Body: By creating an account or placing an order, you confirm that you are at least 18 years old and agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use our services.
terms.s2Body: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activities under your account. Notify us immediately of any unauthorized use of your account.
terms.s3Body: All product descriptions and prices are accurate to the best of our knowledge. We reserve the right to correct errors and update prices at any time. Orders are not confirmed until you receive an order confirmation email.
terms.s4Body: Payment is required at the time of purchase. We accept Visa, Mastercard, Google Pay, and Cash on Delivery. All transactions are processed securely through encrypted payment gateways.
terms.s5Body: All content on TechVibe — including logos, product images, and text — is owned by TechVibe or its licensors and is protected by copyright law. Unauthorized reproduction or use is strictly prohibited.
terms.s6Body: TechVibe is not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from use of our services. Our total liability shall not exceed the amount paid for the specific product or service in question.
terms.s7Body: We may update these Terms at any time. Continued use of our services after changes constitutes acceptance of the new terms. We will notify registered users of significant changes via email.
terms.contact: For legal inquiries, contact us at:

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.subtitle: We use cookies to enhance your experience and analyze our traffic.
cookies.intro: This Cookie Policy explains how TechVibe uses cookies and similar technologies. By continuing to use our site, you consent to our use of cookies as described in this policy.
cookies.whatBody: Cookies are small text files placed on your device when you visit a website. They help websites remember your preferences, keep you logged in, and provide analytics data to improve the user experience.
cookies.essentialDesc: Required for the site to function. They enable core features like login, shopping cart, and security. Cannot be disabled.
cookies.functionalDesc: Remember your preferences such as language and theme settings for a more personalized experience.
cookies.analyticsDesc: Help us understand how visitors use our site so we can improve performance and content.
cookies.marketingDesc: Used to show you relevant ads based on your interests. We do not sell this data to third parties.
cookies.howBody: You can control cookie preferences using the toggles above, or through your browser settings. Note that disabling some cookies may affect site functionality.
cookies.contact: For cookie-related questions, contact us at:
